description: Refinements and extensions to rear of property across multiple levels. At lower ground floor, non-original conservatory improved by removing low external wall, installing full-height glazed sliding doors with minimalist dark metal frames, and reinstating larger external steps. On ground floor, existing glazed flat roof will be replaced with a solid floor structure to form a new glass-box extension. Ground-floor closet wing will be extended in matching brick to align with No.ÿ40, with new minimal dark framed glazed doors to the garden. The new glass box extension will include full-height glazed sliding doors with minimalist dark metal frames and a Juliet balcony with dark metal railings. First and second floor levels, closet wing will be extended to align with No.ÿ42, constructed in matching brickwork, with associated works.
